detail: The two compiled-plan check paths carried a copy each of the run-retain loop and the promote-and-stamp block, and disagreed on the timestamp (two Local::now, one Utc::now), so two guards checked at the same instant recorded different-looking last_checked strings. They now share run_plan_runs, plan_check_result and mark_checked. The REPROIT_FUZZ_CONFIG define is written once instead of at five call sites. No behavior change beyond the timestamp converging on Local::now, which two of the three paths already used; verified by 992 lib tests, every integration test, and hermetic-e2e 4/4, gate-quarantine-e2e 4/4, refresh-e2e 5/5 with unchanged case counts.
